entities.name: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine

entities.summary: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM) in Hamburg is Germany's largest institution for tropical medicine, with a workforce of about 250 people in Hamburg. It is member of the Leibniz-Association.
